nodes.label: Arihant Trading Corporation

nodes.label: BDA Technologies
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Business Operating System
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Connect sales, tendering, demos, service, field ops, expenses, tasks and reporting into one layer; goal is visibility and accountability, not merely digitising forms.

nodes.label: Not a Full ERP Boundary
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Tally accounting, inventory ERP, payroll, quotation/pricing engine, procurement ERP, automatic portal submission, travel booking and GeM functionality stay outside BOS; BOS coordinates, tracks and reports around them.

nodes.label: Tally
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: GeM Portal
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: WhatsApp
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Enter Once Use Everywhere
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Employees should not recreate their day at night for reporting; workflow data auto-feeds customer history, activity, sales, tender/visit/demo reporting and dashboards. Success depends on reducing data entry.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Users see modules according to responsibility; final permissions configured during implementation.

nodes.label: Management Role
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Full operational and reporting visibility.

nodes.label: Regional Manager Role
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Regional sales, visits, leads, tender pipeline and employee performance.

nodes.label: Sales Team Role
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Leads, interactions, visits, demos, proposals, personal tasks.

nodes.label: Tender Team Role
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Tender identification, approval, submission, deadlines, results.

nodes.label: Demo Team Role
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Demo planning, equipment coordination, execution, outcome tracking.

nodes.label: Service Team Role
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Complaints, tickets, field visits, closure.

nodes.label: Accounts Team Role
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Expense submission, verification, approval status.

nodes.label: Admin Role
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Users, departments, master records, permissions.

nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Tender Management Module

nodes.label: Service and After-Sales Management Module

nodes.label: Management Command Dashboard
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Fresh vs Re-Approached Lead
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Re-approached prospects must link to existing organisation/contact history instead of creating duplicate records.

nodes.label: Customer Interaction Timeline
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Calls, email, WhatsApp, visits, demos, proposals, follow-ups, tender and service discussions form one chronological customer history.

nodes.label: Manager Intervention in Planned Visits
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Managers add meetings to an existing trip to improve utilisation, increase meetings per trip, and reduce unnecessary/last-minute travel cost.

nodes.label: Visit Changes Notification
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Cancel/reschedule/destination/date change notifies manager, requires reason, logged in audit trail.

nodes.label: Post-Visit Update
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Weekly Visit Planning Cycle
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Demo Request
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Demo Status Lifecycle
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Requested, Under Planning, Confirmed, Equipment Reserved, Team Assigned, Completed, Cancelled, Rescheduled.

nodes.label: Demo Team Assignment
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Demo Equipment Availability
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Equipment tracked by product, model, serial, location (e.g. Patna, Delhi, Kolkata), condition, reservation; salespeople check before committing.

nodes.label: Demo Equipment Reservation
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Responsible person approves/rejects/suggests alternative/allocates another unit to reduce conflicting bookings.

nodes.label: Demo Outcome and Failure Analysis
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Capture why demos succeed or fail (product limitation, equipment issue, pricing, competitor, etc.) so management can analyse recurring failure patterns.

nodes.label: Tender Identification
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Tender Classification PQ vs General MHA
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: At minimum differentiate PQ (Pre-Qualification) and General/MHA tenders; other categories configurable.

nodes.label: Zone and Region Structure
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Enables reporting at organisation, zone, region and salesperson levels; Arihant provides region mapping.

nodes.label: Tender Approval Workflow
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Identified, Internal Review, Approved/Rejected, Preparation, Submitted, Result Tracking; replaces WhatsApp approvals so decisions are not lost in chats.

nodes.label: Tender Status Lifecycle
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Identified, Awaiting Internal Approval, Rejected Internally, Under Preparation, PQ Submitted, PQ Qualified, Tender Submitted, Technical Evaluation, Commercial Evaluation, Won, Lost, Cancelled, On Hold.

nodes.label: Tender Deadline Management
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Tender External Portal Issues
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Record portal issues (e.g. equipment missing on GeM) with escalation and resolution; portal functionality itself out of scope.

nodes.label: Tender Win Loss Analysis
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Tender Reporting
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Totals, PQ and General/MHA counts (requested by Vikas), win rate, zone/region/salesperson pipelines.

nodes.label: Vikas
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Proposal Register
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Proposal Workflow
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Requested, Under Preparation, Ready for Review, Approved, Sent to Customer, Follow-up Required, Converted/Closed/Lost; tracking only, no automated quotation/pricing.

nodes.label: Proposal Follow-Up
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Salesperson remains responsible after sending; highlights proposals without follow-up to close the gap between sending and knowing the outcome.

nodes.label: Service Ticket
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Service Workflow
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Complaint Received, Ticket Created, Assigned, Visit Scheduled, Work in Progress, Resolved, Service Report Submitted, Ticket Closed; plus Awaiting Part, Awaiting Customer, Escalated, Revisit Required.

nodes.label: Service Report
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Service Management Dashboard
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Removes uncertainty about pending vs completed service work: new/pending/overdue tickets, repeat complaints, avg closure time, workload.

nodes.label: Expense Approval Workflow
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Submitted, Manager Review, Approved/Rejected/Clarification Required, Accounts Review, Processed; Tally remains accounting system.

nodes.label: Standardised Expense Reporting
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Replace varied employee Excel formats with one structure filterable by employee, trip, customer, date, category, region, status.

nodes.label: Expense Categories
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Task Assignment
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Task Status Lifecycle
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Not Started, In Progress, Completed, Blocked, Awaiting Approval, Overdue.

nodes.label: Blocker Workflow
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Distinguish poor execution from genuine dependency; managers accept/reject blocker, extend deadline, reassign, escalate.

nodes.label: Employee Accountability
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Performance and Salary Decision Support
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: BOS provides evidence only and must not automatically deduct salary; authorised management/accounts decide per policy and law.

nodes.label: Performance Indicators
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Lead, visit, demo, proposal and tender performance KPIs incl. conversion rate and win rate.

nodes.label: Management by Exception
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Dashboard surfaces what requires management action so management need not open every module.

nodes.label: Notifications and Escalations
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Audit Trail
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Logs user, action, previous value, new value, date/time for deadline changes, tender approvals, visit cancellations, reassignments, expense decisions.

nodes.label: Mobile-First Field Experience
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Field sales/demo/service staff use mobile; minimise long forms, duplicate entry, typing; adoption is a functional requirement.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Scope
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: 16 items: user/role mgmt, lead, visit, demo, equipment, tender, proposal, service, expense, task, productivity, sales/regional performance, dashboard, notifications, reporting, audit trail.

nodes.label: Inputs Required From Arihant
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf

nodes.label: Scope Freeze
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Stakeholders review for missing workflows/fields before written approval; then architecture and development begin.

nodes.label: Change Management
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Minor refinements absorbed; new modules, integrations, accounting, pricing, new portals treated as additional scope affecting commercials/timeline.

nodes.label: Recommended Implementation Sequence
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: 9 stages: roles/master data; lead/visit; tender/proposal; demo/equipment; service; task/productivity/expense; dashboards/reports/notifications; pilot; org-wide rollout.

nodes.label: Expected Transformation
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: From WhatsApp/Excel/scattered portals to structured workflows with clear ownership and operational activity automatically becoming reporting data.

nodes.label: End-to-End BOS Flow
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Lead -> Interaction -> Visit -> Demo -> Proposal -> Tender/Opportunity -> Service -> Tasks & Follow-Ups -> Performance -> Management Dashboard, supported by Equipment, Expenses, Notifications, Audit Trail.

nodes.label: Core Outcome Operational Coordination Layer
nodes.source_file: docs/Arihant Trading Corporation BOS Scope Blueprint.pdf
nodes.rationale: Every important activity has owner, status, next action, deadline, history, management visibility; more control without extra reporting work.
